name: Site Health Check

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This job used to be three bare `curl`s of the live site: no timeout, no retry,
# no classification, no report - and it checked nothing about the automation.
# Result: it went red on any Cloudflare bot challenge / rate limit (noise that
# buried the real signal), while "no blog for 5 days" stayed invisible.
#
# It now runs scripts/site-health.mjs, which:
#   * distinguishes a real breakage (404 / dead page / missing file) from
#     network noise (403 / 429 / timeout -> warning, retried with backoff);
#   * checks content freshness (blog + story), the publish ledger, the sitemap,
#     robots/ads/feed, JSON-LD validity and the publish workflows themselves;
#   * writes a run summary + test_reports/site-health.json;
#   * opens ONE GitHub issue per problem (updated, not spammed) so nothing can
#     rot silently again.
#
# `7 */6 * * *` instead of `0 */6 * * *`: GitHub queues scheduled runs behind
# the :00 pile-up, and this repo's health runs were landing 3-4 hours late.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '7 1,7,13,19 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      offline:
        description: 'Repo-only checks (skip live HTTP)'
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
      max_age_days:
        description: 'Fail if newest post/story is older than N days'
        required: false
        default: '3'

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: site-health
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  health:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: 🩺 Run health checks
        id: health
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          node scripts/site-health.mjs --ci \
            --max-age-days="${{ github.event.inputs.max_age_days || '3' }}" \
            ${{ github.event.inputs.offline == 'true' && '--offline' || '' }} \
            --json test_reports/site-health.json

      - name: 📤 Upload report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: site-health-report
          path: |
            test_reports/site-health.json
            publish-status.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

      - name: 📣 Open or update one tracking issue
        if: steps.health.outcome == 'failure'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          TITLE="Site health: failing checks ($(date -u +%Y-%m-%d))"
          BODY=$(node -e '
            const fs=require("fs");
            let r={failed:[],summary:{}};
            try { r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test_reports/site-health.json","utf8")); } catch {}
            const lines=(r.failed||[]).map(f=>`- **${f.group}** · ${f.name}${f.detail?` — ${f.detail}`:""}`);
            console.log([
              "The scheduled health check found real problems:",
              "",
              lines.join("\n") || "- (see run log)",
              "",
              `Report: ${process.env.RUN_URL}`,
              "",
              "Automation state is also published at https://aitoolsnova.com/publish-status.json",
              "and recorded in `scripts/publish-log.json`.",
              "",
              "Fixes: node scripts/daily-publish-helper.mjs status",
            ].join("\\n"));
          ')
          # One open issue at a time: update the existing one instead of spamming.
          # Find by title (labels may not exist in this repo yet).
          EXISTING=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues?state=open&per_page=30" --jq '.[] | select(.title | startswith("Site health")) | .number' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
          if [ -n "${EXISTING:-}" ] && [ "$EXISTING" != "null" ]; then
            gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$EXISTING" -f body="$BODY" >/dev/null || true
            echo "Updated tracking issue #$EXISTING"
          else
            # The `site-health` label may not exist yet; never let bookkeeping
            # turn a green-looking red run into a second failure.
            gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues" -f title="$TITLE" -f body="$BODY" -f "labels[]=site-health" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
              || gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues" -f title="$TITLE" -f body="$BODY" >/dev/null || true
            echo "Opened tracking issue"
          fi

      - name: 🧹 Close the tracking issue when green
        if: steps.health.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          OPEN=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues?state=open&per_page=30" --jq '.[] | select(.title | startswith("Site health")) | .number' 2>/dev/null || true)
          for n in $OPEN; do
            gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$n" -f state=closed \
              -f state_reason=completed >/dev/null && echo "closed #$n"
          done

      - name: ❌ Fail the run on real problems
        if: steps.health.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          echo "::error title=Site health failed::See the check output above and the tracking issue. Do not ignore this: it means users or the auto-publish pipeline are affected."
          exit 1
